title: Dead or Weak Battery
diagnosis: Dead or discharged battery. Can be caused by leaving accessories on, old battery (over 3 years), or failing alternator. Try jump-starting first. If it doesn't hold charge, replace the battery.
possible_causes: Battery is old and degraded (over 3 years)
Left car accessories on for extended period
Short circuit in the electrical system
urgency_reason: Car cannot start without battery power.
estimated_fix: Jump-start or battery replacement. If alternator is the root cause, alternator repair needed.

title: Engine Overheating
taglish_symptoms: may tagas na tubig sa radiator
hindi gumagana ang fan ng radiator
diagnosis: Engine is overheating. Most common causes are low coolant, clogged radiator, broken thermostat, or failed water pump. STOP DRIVING IMMEDIATELY to prevent engine damage.
urgency_reason: Continuing to drive will cause severe engine damage. Pull over and let it cool down.
estimated_fix: Refill coolant if low. If radiator or thermostat, replacement needed. Head gasket is expensive — do not ignore overheating.

title: Squeaking or Grinding Brakes
taglish_symptoms: naka-on ang brake light sa dashboard
diagnosis: Brake pads are likely worn and need replacement. Squeaking = pads almost worn. Grinding = pads fully worn, metal-to-metal contact. Get brakes serviced immediately.
possible_causes: Brake pads worn past safe limit
Wet or dirty brake pads (temporary squeak)
urgency_reason: Worn brakes mean reduced stopping power. Unsafe to drive on Metro Manila roads.
estimated_fix: Brake pad replacement. If discs are also damaged, replace both pads and discs.

title: Check Engine Light On
symptoms: engine running normally but light stays on
taglish_symptoms: patuloy na naka-on ang warning light
diagnosis: The OBD-II system has detected a fault and stored a Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC). Need to scan the car with an OBD-II scanner to read the exact code. Could be anything from a loose gas cap to a major engine issue.
possible_causes: Loose or missing gas cap (most common, easiest fix)
urgency_reason: If the light is steady, you can drive to a shop. If it is flashing, reduce speed and go directly to a mechanic.
estimated_fix: Get an OBD scan first (₱200-500 at most shops). Fix depends on the actual code.

title: Engine Knocking or Rattling
symptoms: loud banging from under the hood
knocking gets worse at higher RPM
taglish_symptoms: may ingay na rattle kapag nag-accelerate
malakas na tunog sa ilalim ng hood
mas malakas ang tunog kapag mabilis
diagnosis: Engine knocking can indicate low oil, bad fuel octane, worn connecting rods, or carbon buildup. Low oil knocking is serious. Check oil level immediately.
possible_causes: Spark plugs worn or wrong gap
urgency_reason: If caused by low oil, continuing to drive will destroy the engine. Stop and check oil first.
estimated_fix: Top up oil if low. If knocking continues, need engine inspection. Connecting rod failure is expensive.

title: Transmission Shuddering or Jerking
diagnosis: Transmission fluid may be low or degraded, or there could be a transmission component failure. For automatic transmissions, this often means the fluid needs changing. For manual, check clutch and transmission fluid.
possible_causes: Worn transmission bands or clutch plates
urgency_reason: Driving with transmission issues can cause total transmission failure, which is very expensive to repair.
estimated_fix: Transmission fluid change if that is the issue. Full transmission repair or replacement is ₱30,000-100,000+.

title: Flat or Punctured Tire
taglish_symptoms: hinahawakan ang kotse sa isang side
may malakas na tunog na thump
diagnosis: Tire has a puncture or is severely under-inflated. If visibly flat, do not drive. Use the spare tire or call for roadside assistance.
possible_causes: Nail, screw, or sharp object in the tire
Tire too old and cracked (sidewall blowout)
Tire pressure too low from neglect
urgency_reason: Driving on a flat tire damages the rim and is unsafe, especially on expressways.
common_ph_vehicles: All vehicles — especially pickup trucks on rough PH roads
estimated_fix: Vulcanize (repair) if puncture is on tread: ₱100-300. Replace tire if sidewall damage: ₱3,000-8,000 depending on size.

title: Air Conditioning Not Cooling
symptoms: AC smell is musty or bad
diagnosis: Could be low refrigerant (gas), compressor failure, condenser clogged, or a bad expansion valve. In PH climate, AC failure is urgent for comfort and safety during long drives.
urgency_reason: Not an immediate safety issue but dangerous in Philippine heat, especially for long drives. Get it checked soon.
estimated_fix: Recharge gas: ₱1,500-3,000. Compressor replacement: ₱8,000-20,000. Condenser cleaning: ₱500-1,500.

title: Oil Leak Under the Car
symptoms: oil spots or puddle under the car
taglish_symptoms: may tagas na langis sa ilalim ng kotse
may usok sa engine kapag mainit
may sunog na bango sa engine
diagnosis: Oil is leaking from a gasket, seal, or fitting. Find the source of the leak. If oil level is critically low, do not drive. Top up oil immediately and get it inspected.
urgency_reason: Low oil will cause engine seizure. Top up oil and get to a mechanic before driving far.
estimated_fix: Gasket replacement: ₱2,000-8,000 depending on which gasket. Oil seal: ₱1,500-5,000 labor included.

title: Heavy or Stiff Steering
symptoms: steering wheel is very hard to turn
steering feels heavy especially when parked
steering gets worse at low speed
taglish_symptoms: mabigat ang steering lalo kapag parked
may ingay na whine sa steering
diagnosis: Power steering system issue. Most common is low steering fluid. Could also be a worn power steering pump or rack and pinion problem.
urgency_reason: Heavy steering makes the car harder to control, especially in tight turns and emergency maneuvers.
estimated_fix: Refill steering fluid: ₱300-500. Power steering pump replacement: ₱5,000-15,000.

title: Loud Exhaust or Backfiring
symptoms: smell of exhaust inside the cabin
visible rust or hole in exhaust pipe
taglish_symptoms: may popping na tunog sa exhaust
nababahala ang amoy ng exhaust sa loob
may bukas o kalawangin sa exhaust pipe
diagnosis: Exhaust system has a leak or a component has failed. Could be a cracked muffler, broken exhaust pipe, or a bad catalytic converter. Exhaust fumes inside the cabin are dangerous.
possible_causes: Exhaust pipe joint loose or broken
urgency_reason: Exhaust fumes (carbon monoxide) entering the cabin is a health emergency. Open windows and get to a shop immediately.
estimated_fix: Muffler replacement: ₱3,000-8,000. Exhaust pipe repair: ₱1,500-4,000. Catalytic converter: ₱15,000-40,000.

title: Bouncy or Rough Ride
symptoms: car sways or dips on one side
car feels unstable at high speed
taglish_symptoms: nag-tilt ang kotse sa isang side
may tunog na knock sa bumps
diagnosis: Suspension components are worn. On Philippine roads with many potholes, suspension wears faster than average. Most likely worn shock absorbers or struts.
possible_causes: Loose or worn tie rod ends
urgency_reason: Poor suspension affects braking and handling. Dangerous on wet or uneven PH roads.
estimated_fix: Shock absorber replacement: ₱3,000-10,000 per unit. Full suspension overhaul: ₱15,000-40,000.

title: Poor Fuel Economy
symptoms: fuel running out faster than usual
diagnosis: Multiple possible causes. Common ones in PH: dirty or clogged fuel filter, worn spark plugs, dirty air filter, or oxygen sensor fault. Metro Manila traffic also contributes heavily to poor fuel economy.
urgency_reason: Not a safety issue but costs money. Get routine maintenance done.
estimated_fix: Spark plugs: ₱500-2,000. Air filter: ₱200-500. Fuel filter: ₱500-2,000. Oxygen sensor: ₱2,000-5,000.

title: Alternator or Charging System Failure
diagnosis: Alternator is not charging the battery while the engine runs. The battery will eventually die even if it is new. Replace the alternator.
urgency_reason: Car will stall when battery drains completely. Do not drive far from a mechanic.
estimated_fix: Alternator replacement: ₱5,000-15,000 including labor. Belt: ₱500-1,500.

title: Radiator Leak or Coolant Leak
taglish_symptoms: may tagas na coolant sa kotse
diagnosis: Radiator or a coolant hose has a leak. Could also be a cracked radiator core or a loose hose clamp. Top up coolant and get to a shop — do not let the engine overheat.
urgency_reason: Coolant loss will cause overheating quickly. Top up and get to a mechanic.
estimated_fix: Radiator replacement: ₱8,000-25,000. Hose replacement: ₱1,000-3,000. Radiator cap: ₱200-500.

title: Car Pulling to One Side
symptoms: car drifts or pulls to one side
car feels like it wants to turn
had to hit a pothole recently
taglish_symptoms: hinahawakan ng kotse sa isang side
diagnosis: Wheel alignment is off. Very common in the Philippines due to potholes and rough roads. Needs realignment at a shop with alignment equipment.
possible_causes: Hit a pothole or road bump hard
urgency_reason: Misalignment causes uneven tire wear and reduces handling precision. Not immediately dangerous but should be fixed soon.
common_ph_vehicles: All vehicles — especially on Metro Manila and provincial roads
estimated_fix: Wheel alignment: ₱500-1,500. If tie rod or ball joints are worn, replacement is ₱2,000-8,000.

title: Starter Motor Not Working
symptoms: engine cranks slowly or not at all
car won't start but battery is fine
lights are bright but engine won't crank
taglish_symptoms: may click click kapag sinusi ang susi
may grinding na ingay sa starter
hindi gumagana ang kotse kahit bago ang battery
maliwanag ang mga ilaw pero hindi nag-start
diagnosis: Starter motor has failed or the connection to it is bad. Battery is fine but the starter cannot draw enough current to crank the engine. Replace the starter.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded starter cable connections
urgency_reason: Car cannot start. Need towing or on-site repair.
estimated_fix: Starter motor replacement: ₱4,000-12,000 including labor.

title: Worn or Fouled Spark Plugs
diagnosis: Spark plugs are worn, fouled, or have wrong gap. They are a consumable part and need regular replacement (every 20,000-40,000 km depending on type). Very cheap fix with big performance impact.
possible_causes: Spark plugs over their service life
Oil fouling on spark plugs (indicates deeper issue)
Wrong type of spark plug installed
urgency_reason: Safe to drive short distances but engine performance is degraded. Replace soon.
estimated_fix: Spark plugs: ₱500-2,500 for a full set. Labor: ₱500-1,500.

title: Fuel Pump Failure
symptoms: engine cuts out at highway speed
taglish_symptoms: may ingay na whine sa fuel tank
diagnosis: Fuel pump is not delivering enough fuel to the engine. The engine starves for fuel, especially at higher load or speed. Common in older vehicles in PH heat.
possible_causes: Fuel filter severely clogged (starving the pump)
urgency_reason: Car will stall unpredictably. Dangerous in traffic, especially on expressways.
estimated_fix: Fuel pump replacement: ₱5,000-18,000. Fuel filter: ₱500-2,000 — always check filter first.

title: Clutch Slipping (Manual Cars)
symptoms: engine RPM rises but car doesn't accelerate
clutch pedal feels loose or high
hard to pull off from stop
taglish_symptoms: tumataas ang RPM pero hindi nag-aaccelerate
may sunog na bango kapag nag-shift
nag-jerk ang kotse kapag kinuha ang clutch
diagnosis: Clutch plate is worn and slipping. The clutch can no longer grip the flywheel properly. Needs clutch replacement — this is a manual transmission issue only.
possible_causes: Clutch plate worn past usable life
urgency_reason: Slipping clutch means the car cannot transmit power properly. Risk of stalling in traffic.
estimated_fix: Clutch replacement: ₱8,000-25,000 for parts and labor. Requires transmission removal.

title: Uneven Tire Wear
symptoms: tires worn unevenly across the tread
one side of tire worn more
center or edges worn more than the other
taglish_symptoms: isa na side mas mabilis magastos
hinahawakan ang kotse sa isang side
diagnosis: Tires are wearing unevenly due to misaligned wheels, incorrect tire pressure, or worn suspension parts. Get alignment and check tire pressure immediately to prevent premature tire failure.
possible_causes: Tire pressure too high or too low
urgency_reason: Worn tires reduce grip, especially in wet conditions which are very common in the Philippines during rainy season.
estimated_fix: Alignment: ₱500-1,500. Tire rotation: ₱200-500. Tire replacement if worn: ₱3,000-8,000 each.

title: Engine Oil Needs Changing
symptoms: car hasn't had oil change in 3+ months
mileage since last oil change exceeded recommendation
taglish_symptoms: matagal na hindi na-change ang oil
mas malakas ang tunog ng engine
diagnosis: Engine oil is due for a change. Fresh oil lubricates better, runs cooler, and protects the engine. In PH heat and traffic, oil degrades faster than in other climates. Change every 3-4 months or 5,000 km.
possible_causes: PH heat and traffic degrade oil faster
Wrong oil type or viscosity used previously
urgency_reason: Not urgent unless oil is critically low. But delaying oil changes shortens engine life.
estimated_fix: Oil change at talyer (local shop): ₱500-1,000. At casa (dealership): ₱1,500-3,500. Use the correct oil grade for your car.

title: Water Pump Failure
symptoms: coolant leaking from front of engine
grinding or whining noise from engine
taglish_symptoms: may tagas na coolant sa harap ng engine
may grinding na ingay sa engine
may squealing na ingay sa belt
diagnosis: Water pump has failed. It is responsible for circulating coolant through the engine. Failure causes overheating rapidly. Needs immediate replacement.
possible_causes: Water pump seal worn — causing coolant leak
Timing belt or chain driven pump failed with belt/chain
urgency_reason: Engine will overheat quickly without coolant circulation. Can cause catastrophic engine damage if ignored.
estimated_fix: Water pump replacement: ₱5,000-18,000 including labor. If timing belt driven, replace timing belt at the same time.

title: Exhaust Leak or Muffler Damage
symptoms: visible soot or rust on exhaust
taglish_symptoms: nababahala ang exhaust smell sa loob ng kotse
may popping o hissing na tunog
may soot o kalawangin sa exhaust
diagnosis: Exhaust system has a leak. If you can smell exhaust inside the car, this is a carbon monoxide hazard. Pull over, open windows, and stop driving immediately.
possible_causes: Muffler cracked from age or road damage
Impact damage from pothole or road debris
urgency_reason: Carbon monoxide from exhaust leaks is toxic and odorless. Exhaust smell inside is a serious health and safety hazard.
estimated_fix: Muffler: ₱2,000-6,000. Exhaust pipe repair or replacement: ₱1,500-5,000. Full exhaust system: ₱8,000-20,000.

title: Multiple Dashboard Warning Lights On
symptoms: several warning lights on at the same time
all lights flash momentarily then some stay
battery and temperature lights on together
diagnosis: Multiple lights often indicate an electrical or sensor issue. If all lights flash together momentarily, it might just be the car initializing. If they stay on, get an OBD scan to read all the stored codes at once.
possible_causes: Loose ground connection causing multiple false readings
Low battery voltage causing sensor errors
urgency_reason: Depends on which lights. Oil pressure or temperature lights staying on means stop driving. ABS light means brakes may not have ABS protection.
estimated_fix: OBD scan first: ₱200-500. Fix depends on actual codes. Could be as simple as a loose ground wire or as complex as ECU replacement.
